concept.subject: Bamboo water wheels on a shallow mountain river: two whole wheels turning side by side, two more cut by the edges, a bamboo rail across the river, and a misty peak and a green hill behind them under a cloudy sky.
concept.composition: The bigger whole wheel turns right of center, its hub at about 57% of the width and 60% of the height, about half the picture height across; the smaller one turns left of center, its hub at about a quarter of the width and the same height, two fifths of the picture height across. A third wheel is cut by the left edge and a fourth, the largest, by the right edge, with a dark trough across it. A bamboo rail crosses the river at two thirds of the height, long struts prop the wheels, and the shallow water and stones fill the bottom. A misty peak rises right under the cannon at about a quarter of the height, its long ridges falling to either side; a green hill climbs to the upper right; clouds fill the top.
concept.layout: Bricks only, 141. The two whole wheels turn about their hubs, the same way, the smaller one faster: each is a rim of four curved brick arcs with slots between them, the big wheel with fourteen paddles outside its rim and the smaller with four spokes inside it, and each sits under a thin solid crown traced on its upper rim, a shelter over the wheel. The ripples on the shallow water are four short brick rows that flow to the right down a 3 degree slope and start over, the moving ground. The peak under the cannon is a small solid summit whose two flanks are brick slides: the left one runs down the long ridge toward the cut wheel at the left edge, the right one down to the valley. The hill's crest, the cut wheels' rims and troughs, the bamboo rails and struts, the village, the stones and five clouds are short brick runs; the clouds are never orange.

moving.what: the smaller water wheel, turning the same way and faster
four rows of ripples on the shallow water

features: Moving ground and brick wheels (spec 8): the ripples on the river and two water wheels
Bricks only (spec 8): the second of stage 7's two bricks-only levels

difficulty.note: Second hardest: Teggle's draw puts most orange bricks on the two turning wheels, and each wheel's solid crown turns balls away from its top, so they are lit from the sides and from below between the turning rim's slots. The two flank slides from the summit under the cannon are the easy shots; the clouds are never orange, so the high sky does not hand out orange bricks.

background.prompt: Bamboo water wheels on a shallow mountain river under a cloudy sky. Two whole wheels of thin bamboo spokes with dark bucket paddles on their rims stand side by side: the bigger one right of center, its hub at about 57% of the width and 60% of the height, about half the picture height across, and a smaller one left of center, its hub at about a quarter of the width and the same height, two fifths of the picture height across. A third wheel is cut by the left edge and a fourth, the largest, by the right edge, with a dark trough across it at about half the height. A bamboo rail crosses the whole picture at about two thirds of the height, long bamboo struts prop the wheels, and a pale river with stony banks runs behind and below them; muddy shallow water fills the lower left corner and stones the lower right. A misty blue-gray peak rises at the top center at about a quarter of the height, long ridges fall away to either side, and a green hill with tea terraces climbs to the upper right. The top is gray-blue cloud.

picture.title: Row of water wheels between bamboo fence and green mounts under cloudy sky in foggy weather
